delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

outputs.description: The requested output kinds, in the order submitted.

attempts.description: Crashes, boot requeues and transient stage failures so far. Only this is judged against jobs.max_attempts.

evictions.description: Live preemptions so far. They never fail a job.

reason.description: Why it is queued NOW: submitted the first time, live_preempted (evicted, work dir kept), node_restarted (the boot sweep), transient_retry (a transient stage failure with attempts left), disk_insufficient (the box could not fit the job's disk reservation; no counter moves, and it is held back one rescan).

destination_ref.description: The storage.destinations entry the source was read from, with key.

key.description: The source object's key in that destination.

url.description: The HTTPS source, with its query string (a presigned signature) removed.

bytes.description: The source's size once the fetch learned it; absent while unknown.
